title: Soccer/Football Minigame
description: Create a football minigame in seconds without the need of any commands! Feature a 3D soccer ball & management menu, no resource pack required!
body:
# Soccer
![Preview](https://i.imgur.com/jPIvnmQ.gif)

_Once a goal is scored, the ball get teleported to the center._

_The match will end after 10 minutes, there is no score limit during that time_

## Setup

Press 'G' to open the customization menu and just follow the instructions
![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kW4qfczL/images/773892230dafa6ae330aa24ceed911ec459647e3.png)

## Team management & points
You can make players join a specific team with /team join <player> soccer1 or soccer2.
Soccer1 team will defend the goal of team 1, and soccer2, the goal of team 2!

The points from the scoreboard are split by teams!
